name: Braids
description: Leader of Kuberr's contingent, buried alive by Karona.

description_citations.text: "Scourge (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kills creatively rather than snapping a finger to yank a soul.
timeline.quote: I prefer to kill creatively.

citation.text: Ghastly Demise (Odyssey, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Braids finds time for petty extortion amid killing peasants and raising an army of nightmares.
timeline.quote: Braids somehow found time for her favorite hobby: petty extortion.

citation.text: Blackmail (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
timeline.quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
timeline.quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
timeline.quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

citation.text: "Shards of Nightmares" by Phoebe Barton. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Braids carries the Mirari back to Cabal City.
timeline.quote: the Mirari returned to Cabal City, carried by the trickster Braids

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids leads Cabalists to the Mer Empire capital and makes a deal with Laquatus to find the Mirari; Aboshan finds it first and dies.
timeline.quote: she made a deal with Laquatus to find the Mirari for him

citation.text: "Braids", section "To the Mer Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids pockets the Mirari, immune to its lure, and returns it to the First.
timeline.quote: she merely pocketed it and made her way back to Cabal City

citation.text: "Braids", section "To the Mer Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids fights in a rigged pit fight with Skellum and is knocked unconscious but survives.
timeline.quote: she escaped the fight with her life intact

citation.text: "Braids", section "In league with the Patriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Visions of Kuberr send Braids to Aphetto, where she prepares for the Patriarch and becomes his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: was rewarded by becoming his second-in-command

citation.text: "Braids", section "In league with the Patriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids hunts Kamahl with five serpent assassins, who slaughter many but are killed by barbarians.
timeline.quote: killed all five of her snakemen

citation.text: "Braids", section "In league with the Patriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids zombifies Balthor in revenge for Leer and sets him against Laquatus before teleporting away.
timeline.quote: Braids then zombified Balthor in revenge for him killing Leer

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids, Traybor and Eesha reveal Laquatus's treachery and leave him alone in Krosa.
timeline.quote: leaving the merman alone in the forest

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kills Seton and kidnaps Jeska for the Patriarch.
timeline.quote: She then killed the centaur and kidnapped Jeska

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids is injured commanding Cabal forces, used by Akroma, then serves Stonebrow before escaping to rejoin the Cabal.
timeline.quote: She eventually managed to escape and rejoin the Cabal.

citation.text: "Braids", section "The capture of Jeska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids helps Phage and Kuberr survive an assassination attempt and kills the Cabal Patriarch with a nightmare beast.
timeline.quote: she killed the Cabal Patriarch instead with one of her nightmare beasts

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Karona's War Braids falls into fanaticism and is trapped in her own dementia space.
timeline.quote: ended up trapped in her own dementia space

citation.text: "Braids", section "Succumbing to Dementia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cabal summoners drag Braids back from dementia space; she escapes split in two and allies with Shanna, Tiana and Rafwyn to kill her shard-self.
timeline.quote: Braids escaped from her dementia space during the second Phyrexian invasion, but split in two.

citation.text: "Braids", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Belzenlok's death Lagomos maintains the Cabal until members summon Braids to lead them.
timeline.quote: until its members summoned their former member Braids to lead them

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Resurgence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids captures the dying Jeska and brings her to the Cabal Patriarch.
timeline.quote: she ultimately was captured by Braids and brought to the Cabal Patriarch

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Barbarian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids head to the mountains while Laquatus plays them against each other.
timeline.quote: Laquatus tries to play them against each other while pretending to be a friend of both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eesha, Braids and Llawan's envoys reveal Laquatus's plotting and abandon the quest for the Mirari, leaving him without support.
timeline.quote: They decide to leave the former ambassador to his own devices and abandon the quest for the Mirari.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl discovers the assailant is Balthor, zombified by Braids, and ends his undeath in tears.
timeline.quote: he is Balthor, zombified by Braids and instructed to kill Laquatus.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus mind-controls zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who is forced to strike down his old mentor at Balthor's plea.
timeline.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his torment, and so Kamahl was forced to strike down his old mentor.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids kidnaps Jeska, and the Cabal Patriarch turns her into Phage; Kamahl and Phage fight until Akroma interrupts and they defeat her together.
timeline.quote: who tried to kill her, but instead turned her into Phage

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Redemption in Krosa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akroma finds the last unman and names him Umbra, then brainwashes the feeble Braids to learn Cabal secrets.
timeline.quote: Finally, she finds a feeble Braids and brainwashes her to be her follower.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phage gives birth to Kuberr, and Braids recovers her sanity and summons a dementia monster that devours the Patriarch; Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Phage and Braids take control of the Cabal in place of Kuberr.

citation.text: "Legions (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids takes the Mirari back to the Patriarch.
timeline.quote: fell into the hands of Braids

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Braids takes Jeska from Seton's hut and kills Seton; Kamahl finds the hut burned and his sister missing.
timeline.quote: Seton opposed this, and the dementist killed him.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl fights Phage in the pits but his sister does not recognize him, so he stops the match and returns to Krosa to build an army.
timeline.quote: Rejected, Kamahl stops the match and returns to Krosa, where he decides to build an army to defeat the Cabal and rescue his sister.

citation.text: "Onslaught (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona creates a chasm that swallows the rampaging armies, burying them, including Braids, alive.
timeline.quote: she creates a vast chasm underneath the armies that swallows them whole and then fills it again, burying them, including Braids, alive.

citation.text: "Scourge (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
